text:
Maya (sec): Vendor wants a 2h retest slot next Friday 21:00-23:00 UTC to validate fixes for high/critical buckets. We need a tight plan: RBAC/timeboxed creds, KMS access scope, audit snapshot, and a clear remediation->retest flow.
Lucas (SRE): We can support if we get a deploy freeze during the window and a rollback job prepped. Also prefer a 30m dry-run earlier that day.
Ravi (infra): Ephemeral keys only. I'll generate a namespaced key with a 3h TTL and limited services (s3, logs). No long-lived IAM roles. Example via keyctl:
```
keyctl create --name pt-1920012345 --ttl 3h --services s3,logs --tag pt=1920012345
```
Priya (eng): On RBAC: will create a confined Role in namespace pt-run-1920012345 with allowed verbs: get/list/watch on pods, deployments; get on secrets:metadata. No exec/port-forward. Will open PR and include smoke checks.
Maya (sec): Policy constraints: 1) Assessor cannot escalate privileges, 2) No terminal access to prod nodes, 3) All actions must be audited and forwarded to the evidence bucket.
legal-bot: NDA check: vendor agreement V-334 valid through 2026-06-30. Assessor SOW signed.
Lucas (SRE): For audit, target bucket s3://pentest-evidence/1920012345 (SSE, immutability 90d). evidence-bot, can you provision the bucket + manifest?
evidence-bot: Bucket created: s3://pentest-evidence/1920012345. Manifest URL: https://ci.internal/artifacts/pt/1920012345/manifest.json. Fields: pt_run_id, start_ts, end_ts, included_streams, signatures.
Priya (eng): Sample RoleBinding snippet I'll put in the PR:
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: pt-assessor-limited
  namespace: pt-run-1920012345
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods","services","endpoints"]
  verbs: ["get","list","watch"]
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["get"]
  resourceNames: []  # metadata-only
```
Maya (sec): Also: require assessor to run non-destructive tests only unless pre-approved. Any remediation PRs they propose must be draft and go to pentest-triage for review. No direct merges.
Ravi (infra): After window, I'll revoke the key and push a signed revocation to the artifact bucket. Include revocation_signature in manifest.
Lucas (SRE): Rollback triggers: auth 5xx spike >8%, unexpected high egress, or any data-exfil indicator. Action: run `pt-retest-rollback-1920012345` job (one-click). I'll prepare the script and circuit-breaker.
Priya (eng): PR will include smoke commands: `kubectl auth can-i get pods --as=assessor@vendor.com -n pt-run-1920012345` and `aws s3 cp testfile s3://pentest-evidence/1920012345 --profile assessor-token`.
Maya (sec): audit-bot: define required event fields for evidence package (RBAC-change, key-create, key-revoke, access attempts).
audit-bot: Required fields: event_id, timestamp, actor, action, resource_type, resource_id, pt_run_id, assessor_id, payload_hash, signature. Sample events posted to runbook.
Priya (eng): I'll wire automation: label `pt:ready-for-retest` moves ticket to "Awaiting Retest" and sets due date + retest owner. Also add a column "Recheck Evidence" for post-retest verification.
Maya (sec): Legal confirmed NDA. I'll share assessor contact and rules of engagement in the runbook: https://runbooks.internal/pt/1920012345. Include list of allowed subjects and exact k8s subjects.
Lucas (SRE): Dry-run proposed at 18:30 UTC same day. Will run smoke test, audit forwarding check, and simulate revoke.
Ravi (infra): Confirming key rotation post-window and audit entry for rotation.
Maya (sec): Owners: 
- RBAC PR: Priya (will open PR today)
- Ephemeral key + revoke: Ravi
- Rollback job + alerts: Lucas
- Evidence bucket + manifest: evidence-bot
- NDA/contact: Maya/legal-bot
React with :white_check_mark: on your item.
Priya (eng): :white_check_mark: (PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/4999)
Ravi (infra): :white_check_mark: (key flow ready)
Lucas (SRE): :white_check_mark: (rollback + alerts ready)
evidence-bot: :white_check_mark: (manifest uploaded)
Maya (sec): I'll run the planning call tomorrow 09:00 PT and post final runbook link after dry-run. Thanks all.
